advanced.prompt: أي تفسير دقيق يميز هذا البناء عن الأنماط المرتبطة؟
options: Always add there after a where relative clause for the same place.
Where relative clauses must use inverted direct-question order.
Where can provide the location relation; do not redundantly add there for the same place.
advanced.answer: Where can provide the location relation; do not redundantly add there for the same place.
